description: Issue #145, exclusion 2 of 4: 「既存の unit test が緑のまま」/ "Existing unit tests still pass". That is a REGRESSION condition — satisfied by touching no test file at all — so a scope with no test path in it is right rather than short. Both criteria also say 追加 / "added" about the CHANGE, which is precisely why the positive rule fires without this exclusion and why the case goes red when it is removed. 既存 / existing on its own must not veto (「既存のテストに1件追加する」 is a real demand), so the exclusion needs the stays-as-it-is half inside the same clause; the bounded gap that never crosses a 。 / "." is what enforces that.
